identity.description: Coda, a document/workspace platform combining docs, tables and rows. It was renamed Superhuman Docs on July 8, 2026; coda.io/developers now redirects to Superhuman's developer docs at docs.superhuman.com.
identity.identity_notes: The assignment URL coda.io/developers 307-redirects to docs.superhuman.com/developers, which describes the product as formerly Coda. Superhuman's launch post says 'Coda is now Superhuman Docs'. Same product, same API (coda.io/apis/v1 base path).

auth.oauth_flows: unknown. No OAuth grant was found in the API docs. A third-party aggregator says the Docs MCP server uses OAuth or API key, which was not verified on a Superhuman page.
auth.token_refresh: unknown. Static API token; no refresh flow documented in fetched pages.
auth.scopes_notes: Token can reportedly be restricted to read, write, or both, and to a single doc or table (third-party Make guide only, unverified). API usage follows the role of the token owner in the workspace.

access.production_restrictions: No app review found for the personal API token path. The token owner must be a Doc Maker or Admin in the workspace to create docs. Not confirmed for OAuth integrations.

read_ops: Discover pages, tables, formulas, and controls
write_ops: Create new docs and copy existing ones
Insert, upsert, update, and delete rows
api.rate_limits: Reading: 100 requests per 6 seconds. Writing (POST/PUT/PATCH): 10 requests per 6 seconds. Writing doc content: 5 per 10 seconds. Listing docs: 4 per 6 seconds. Exceeding returns HTTP 429.
api.limitations: Writes are asynchronous: they return HTTP 202 with a requestId, checked via a mutation-status endpoint. Webhooks not mentioned in fetched docs. Only official client library is Google Apps Script; other libraries are unsupported. Write coverage appears centered on docs and rows.

open_questions: Does Superhuman's API docs mention webhooks? Not found in fetched pages.
Does the Docs MCP server (docs.superhuman.com/apis/mcp) use OAuth, API key, or both? The page returned 401 to WebFetch; claims rest on a third-party aggregator.
Is there a trial, sandbox, or test workspace separate from a free workspace? Not found.
Does coda.io/apis/v1 still work after the rename? Help-center snippet says yes, but the article returned 403 and was not read.
Are there official GitHub repos under a Superhuman or Coda org for the MCP or API? None found in search.
Exact OAuth scopes or integration app-review requirements for the API are unknown.
Developer portal and API docs were 307-redirected from coda.io; the docs.superhuman.com API page was read via summarization, so some quotes are paraphrases and are marked unverified.
